groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.814% and the 10Y at 5.272%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 2 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -0.19% over five sessions and +2.10% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +3.62% at about $101.58, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-13/100, 64% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.272%, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -0.05% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -13/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -14 → now -13; open -8 → now -13 (deteriorated 5 points).

The main live drivers are Rates are mixed: the 10Y is 5.272%, -4.5 bp since the opening snapshot. Volatility are a headwind: VXN 23.74 (+5.70%) | VIX 17.07 (+4.47%). It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is mixed: 4.814% (-7.3 bp vs prev close).
QQQ is near flat and internals are not yet producing a decisive directional confirmation (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher.
Semiconductor catalyst context: NVIDIA $150B additional share-repurchase authorization. Positive catalyst; weak/isolated sector read-through; Persisting 3 sessions later.
